description: Issue #815, absorbing #716: a built-in **Command** used where a value is required is statically decidable, because a built-in's Kind is fixed by the C3 matrix — so it is reported at the semantic layer (`spec/tooling.md:193`) with the built-in's canonical spelling in `procedure`. Measured before this slice, `wait forward 5` ran, waited for nothing, and reported nothing, while the same fault in `wait p` (a user procedure) reported correctly — the inconsistency #716 recorded and asked NOT to be fixed one form at a time. The rule is positional, so `repeat forward 5 [ … ]`, `right forward 5`, `when`/`every`'s operands and `print forward 5` all report identically.
